comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
For those who may not yet have known (and it's not like the game itself ever flat-out tells you)...

To pull a quest, you must: meet the required fame, and also have found any necessary pre-discoveries/quests/port permits.

To share a quest with others, your fleet members must: have found the necessary pre-discoveries/quests/port permits. Their fame doesn't matter.

This rule applies absolutely to all quests.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: It is possible to win the fleet battle with AoS, but you need at least two fleet members spamming it simultaneously at the same time for it to work -- my fleet managed it with three AoS users while a fourth member repaired just to be safe. I find binding AoS to custom slots helped a lot in speeding up usage.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: The 10 ship fleet you have to face at the end has also been made easier: They now fight in Battle Galleon rather then Heavy Galleon so they have a lower durability, armour, crew, and cannon count. It's still a bit difficult to do with AoS alone though. I recommend getting into a battle ship and fit it with armour plates to withstand the cannonfire, or have another player assist you by spamming AoS with you or using repair.
